'''Clan Home''' was the name given to the large ''[[Vheh'yaim/Legends|vheh'yaim]]'' that served as the residence of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Awaud clan]], after they left [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and the [[Great Clan Wars/Legends|conflict]] between [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] and the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] behind to settle on [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]]. Built in the [[Tree/Legends|forested]] northern foothills of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], Clan Home functioned as the ''de facto'' [[Heart/Legends|heart]] of the Mandalorian [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]]. Clan Home possessed an [[Armory/Legends|armory]], kitchen, [[Medical bay/Legends|infirmary]], and family lodgings, and over [[Time/Legends|time]], became an informal headquarters for the hundreds of Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that resided in Arumorut.

==Description==
[[File:Vhehyaim-Insider86.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Clan Home was an example of a large ''[[Vheh'yaim/Legends|vheh'yaim]]'']]
Clan Home was a large ''[[Vheh'yaim/Legends|vheh'yaim]]'' constructed in the center of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]], located in the northern foothills of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]], a sparsely populated industrial world in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The dome-shaped Clan Home was fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] wide, constructed with hard [[Tree/Legends|wood]] from the local [[Conifer/Legends|conifer]] tree forests around Arumorut, and its outer face was surfaced with tree bark, [[Grass/Legends|grass]], and mud for camouflage. Two narrow, reinforced cylindrical towers rose from Clan Home's domed surface, measuring ten and fifteen meters high, from which [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooters]] could defend the homestead.<ref name="FLT" /> Like most ''vheh'yaime'',<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> Clan Home's base was set several meters into the ground, with a sunken main entrance at the foot of a small staircase.<ref name="FLT" />

Through the main entrance was a small atrium, that led into a thirty-meter-wide common room known in [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] as the ''karyai'',<ref name="FLT" /> or "main living room."<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> Clan Home's ''karyai'' possessed rustic but functional decor that included a mixture of exposed wood, roughhewn furniture, and industrial tables. Five long tables ran the room's length, and the ''karyai'' could easily accommodate several hundred guests, and it was here that [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Clan Awaud's]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]], [[Vera Beroya/Legends|Vera Beroya]], hosted her entire clan for communal feasts and mission planning. Clan Home also housed an [[Armory/Legends|armory]], a large kitchen, a study, an [[Medical bay/Legends|infirmary]], and private living quarters for both the chieftain and twenty of the clan's most senior members and top [[Army/Legends|military]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]], in addition to their families. A network of several underground tunnels connected Clan Home with sixteen smaller ''vheh'yaime'' across Arumorut; known as ''akaata'yaime'', these sixteen other structures served as [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] for Clan Awaud's [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]].<ref name="FLT" />

==History==
After Clan Awaud left Mandalore to escape the intersocietal struggles between the pacifist [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] and the radical [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], they wandered the galaxy for several years before eventually settling on the Outer Rim world of Vlemoth Port. Using the resources afforded to them by the dense, coniferous forests of the northern foothills, the Mandalorians of Clan Awaud built a large ''vheh'yaim'' residence they deemed Clan Home. Here, Chieftain [[Nam Beroya/Legends|Nam Beroya]] and the clan's senior members took up residence, as the village of Arumorut grew up around them.<ref name="FLT" />

After Nam Beroya was [[Slavery/Legends|captured]] by [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] in the course of a heated battle with a party of [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], his [[Gai bal manda|adopted]] daughter Vera succeeded him as Clan Awaud's chieftain and the head of Clan Home's household. From Clan Home's ''karyai'', Vera Beroya directed the collective mercenary operations of Arumorut's warriors, and hosted great feasts for the many members of her clan. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], waged between the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the rebellious [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Beroya met with several prospective clients at Clan Home, including a group of rebel operatives looking to enlist Mandalorian aid in the defense of the nearby world of [[Xorrn/Legends|Xorrn]] from Imperial assault.<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Home was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="FLT" />
